Features
Everything you need to teach and
learn effectively

From authoring exams to analyzing results — NovaQuiz handles it end to end.

📝

4-step exam wizard

Info → Import JSON → Edit questions → Review. Saves 80% of your time, supports single and multiple-answer questions.

🗂️

Collections & automatic badges

Teachers group exams into a learning path. Students who complete them all automatically earn a badge on their profile.

💳

Credit system

Control access with credits. Admins configure the cost per exam; students see their balance before starting.

💾

Auto-saved progress

Every time you move to the next question, your answer is saved to the server instantly. Closed tab, power outage, lost connection — no answer is ever lost.

🔄

Resume an exam

Log back in on any device — if time remains, the timer picks up exactly where you left off and your answers are fully restored.

⏰

Auto-grade on timeout

A background grader service runs every 15 minutes and automatically grades exams that ran out of time. Students never need to click submit — results are always recorded.

📤

Import questions from JSON

Draft your question bank in Notion or Excel, then import it all at once. Per-question error previews right inside the wizard.

📅

Scheduled publishing

Set an opening time for an exam — students see a countdown, and the start button activates automatically. The server blocks early submissions.

📊

Instant results & explanations

Score, accuracy rate, per-question analysis, and markdown explanations right after submission. Review any time.

💬

Comments, likes & reports

Students discuss under each exam, like the ones they enjoy, and report question issues after taking the exam. Teachers receive & respond to reports right in their inbox.

🔎

Discover exams by tag

Filter exams by topic, sort by newest or most popular. Every card shows likes & comments to help you choose with confidence.

🗒️

Scratch notes while testing

A floating note shared across the whole exam — jot down formulas or outlines without leaving the screen. Private, never sent to the server.

👤

Public profile

Every exam creator gets their own profile page — bio, social links, and a list of their published exams for students to discover.

✨

AI-generated exams

Upload a PDF, DOCX, or text document — the AI drafts a full multiple-choice exam so the teacher just reviews & finishes it.

🎁

Refer a friend, earn credits New

Invite friends with your own referral link — both sides earn credits once the referee upgrades to teacher or completes a paid action.

🔔

Multi-channel notifications New

Get alerted when a submission is graded, a comment gets a reply, a report is resolved, and more — via Email, Pushover, or Telegram. Pick channels & event types on your profile.

🔑

Teacher API New

Issue your own API key to automate exam creation & management from a script, no browser session required.

Security & anti-cheat
One exam,
one device only

The system tracks sessions in real time: while one device is taking an exam, any other device logging into the same account is blocked immediately.

  • ✓ A unique session token per submission — can't be shared
  • ✓ A heartbeat every 30s to detect disconnected devices
  • ✓ API responses encrypted with AES-256-GCM — ECDH key exchange
  • ✓ Auto-recovery after 5 minutes without a heartbeat (crash / lost connection)

🛡️ Exam security status

🔒
Exclusive session
This device holds the active session. Any other device that tries to join is blocked with a clear message.
💾
Continuous auto-save
Answers are saved on every question change plus a 30-second heartbeat, even while the user is just reading.
🔐
End-to-end encryption
The backend encrypts every API response. A proxy or packet sniffer only ever sees ciphertext.
⏰
Server-authoritative timer
Exam time is tracked on the server — it can't be tampered with via DevTools or local storage edits.

FAQ
Frequently asked questions

Can I use multiple devices at the same time?

No — while taking an exam, the system only allows one active device. Opening it on another device blocks that one. After 5 minutes of inactivity, the old session is released so a new device can take over.

If I close the tab or lose power, is my exam lost?

No. Answers are auto-saved to the server every time you move to the next question and every 30 seconds. When you log back in, the system detects the unfinished exam and restores the exact state — no lost answers, no lost time.

What happens if time runs out before I submit?

A grader service automatically grades every timed-out exam every 15 minutes. Results are recorded based on the answers already saved. Students get an accurate result even without clicking submit.

What are credits, and can I buy more?

Credits are the unit used to take exams — each exam has its own cost. You get 20 credits on sign-up. Currently, admins grant additional credits; a direct purchase system is planned for the future.

How do I become a Teacher?

After signing up as a Student, go to the Profile page → use credits to upgrade to Teacher. Once upgraded, you can create exams, collections, and manage students. You'll need to log out and back in for the role to take effect.

Is my data secure?

Yes. Every API response is encrypted with AES-256-GCM using ECDH P-256 key exchange — data traveling between the browser and server can't be read if intercepted. JWT auth, CASL authorization, and rate limiting protect every endpoint.
